summary: Build practical time management skills with time audits, priority tools, and calendar planning. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Time management training helps professionals turn competing commitments into workable daily and weekly plans. It is designed for project coordinators, supervisors, administrative professionals, and others who plan or deliver time-sensitive work. Participants practise auditing and prioritizing tasks, designing focused calendar blocks, and reviewing weekly plans to manage deadlines and interruptions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who plan, coordinate, or deliver time-sensitive work and need a repeatable way to manage priorities, interruptions, and schedules.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with your own recurring tasks and calendar is useful. No coding is required. For digital exercises, bring access to a spreadsheet application and a digital calendar if available.
